newsitem.title: USA: Recycling Industries sets Miami purchase.
newsitem.headline: Recycling Industries sets Miami purchase.

text.p: Recycling Industries Inc said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to acquire the assets of Sunshine Metal Processing Inc, located in the Miami suburb of Opa Locka, Fla., for $2.5 million.
Sunshine Metal is a full-service metals recycling operation that had 1995 revenues of $24 million. It ceased operations in July 1996 in preparation for the sale of the business.

Recycling Industries said it plans to reopen the plant immediately upon the closing of this acquisition, which is subject to the company obtaining the required financing and resolution of a lawsuit against Sunshine in which a third party claims to have a contract to acquire Sunshine's assets.

Recycling Industries said the cost includes the assumption of approximately $1.25 million of debt and the issuance of $500,000 of the company's convertible preferred stock which may be converted into common stock upon Sunshine's meeting certain performance objectives.
